d:
Patna Protest :patna men BPSC TRE-4, BSSC aur pulis bharti ki mang ko lekar abhyarthiyon ka pradarshan tej ho gaya hai. Gandhi Maidan men pradarshan ke dauran kaee chhatr netaon ko pulis ne diten kiya. vahin, postal park se chhatr neta aman ko bhi hirasat men liya gaya. aakhir abhyarthiyon ki kya mangen hain aur pulis ki karravaee ke bad Patna men kya sthiti hai? dekhie puri riporta.
